activity.notes: Miltiades was one of the ten Athenian strategoi for 490/489 BCE and played the central command role at Marathon. ATLAS records the securely dated 490 BCE military command rather than stretching his wider political career into an artificial continuous interval.

sources.title: Miltiades — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: The Oxford Classical Dictionary identifies Miltiades as one of the ten Athenian strategoi for 490/489 BCE and discusses his decisive role at Marathon.
